def P(x, y):
    return Position(x=x, y=y)
D = Direction
def pick(proto, q):
    move_to(P(q.x, q.y + 3))
    try:
        pickup_entity(proto, q)
    except Exception as e:
        print("pick err", proto, str(e)[:120])
def build():
    pick(Prototype.SteamEngine, P(11.5, 8.5))
    pick(Prototype.SteamEngine, P(16.5, 8.5))
    pick(Prototype.Boiler, P(0, 4.5))
    pick(Prototype.Boiler, P(0, 8.5))
    print("inv", inspect_inventory())
    move_to(P(18, 17))
    bA = place_entity(Prototype.Boiler, position=P(16.5, 15.0), direction=D.DOWN)
    print("bA", bA.position, bA.connection_points, bA.direction)
    bB = place_entity(Prototype.Boiler, position=P(19.5, 15.0), direction=D.DOWN)
    print("bB", bB.position, bB.connection_points)
    move_to(P(18, 10))
    for x in [16.5, 19.5]:
        d = place_entity(Prototype.ElectricMiningDrill, position=P(x, 12.5), direction=D.DOWN)
        print("bdrill", d.position, d.drop_position, d.status)
    try:
        place_entity(Prototype.MediumElectricPole, position=P(18.5, 10.5))
    except Exception as e:
        print("pole1 err", str(e)[:150])
    move_to(P(14, 21))
    e1 = place_entity(Prototype.SteamEngine, position=P(16.5, 20.5), direction=D.DOWN)
    print("e1", e1.position, e1.connection_points)
    e2 = place_entity(Prototype.SteamEngine, position=P(16.5, 25.5), direction=D.DOWN)
    print("e2", e2.position, e2.connection_points, e2.status)
    try:
        place_entity(Prototype.MediumElectricPole, position=P(18.5, 17.5))
    except Exception as e:
        print("pole2 err", str(e)[:150])
    try:
        sp = connect_entities(bA, e1, Prototype.Pipe)
        print("steam", sp)
    except Exception as e:
        print("steam err", str(e)[:200])
    move_to(P(-8, 14))
    wp = nearest(Resource.Water)
    print("wp", wp)
    pump = place_entity(Prototype.OffshorePump, position=wp)
    print("pump2", pump.position, pump.connection_points)
    try:
        wpp = connect_entities(pump, bA, Prototype.Pipe)
        print("water", wpp)
    except Exception as e:
        print("water err", str(e)[:200])
    move_to(P(18, 17))
    bA = get_entity(Prototype.Boiler, P(16.5, 15.0))
    insert_item(Prototype.Coal, bA, 20)
    bB = get_entity(Prototype.Boiler, P(19.5, 15.0))
    insert_item(Prototype.Coal, bB, 5)
build()
